channel.title: Relay Updates
channel.description: Signed updates for Relay on macOS.

item.description:
Relay 0.3.8 improves application search and launcher actions.
- Search friendly app names and aliases from installed app metadata. - Discover installed Epic product names automatically. Unreal Engine now appears as its own result and opens the installed editor, without adding keywords manually. - Put normal apps ahead of matching helper services and debug/shipping variants, while keeping technical names searchable. - Press Return to perform the selected primary action and close the command window. Copy file, Copy path, Copy text and Open folder buttons keep the window open for further actions.
Signed and notarized universal Mac app. Requires macOS 14 or later. Existing library and preferences are preserved.

Relay 0.3.7 improves search discovery across your Mac.
- Finds indexed apps in shared folders and other local volumes automatically. - Continues wider app discovery even when another matching app or service is already found. - Shows matching apps before source files and logs in All, without duplicate app/file rows. - Searches filenames across indexed local volumes by default; choosing a folder keeps that search scoped. - Keeps the command window and current search open after actions, with brief confirmations and manual close controls.
Requires macOS 14 or later. Universal installer for Apple Silicon and Intel Macs.

# Relay 0.3.6
- The search window stays open after copying files, paths, text, clipboard entries or conversions, and after opening files or folders. - Switching to another app keeps your search available. Bringing an already open command window back retains its query. - Close the window yourself with the × button, Escape, or the launcher shortcut while it is focused. - Brief action confirmations remain available.
Requires macOS 14 or later. Universal app for Apple Silicon and Intel Macs. Update through Relay’s Check for Updates menu.
